approval.confirmation_reference: User authorized optimal in-scope execution without repeated approvals.
approval.scope: One immutable 180-second V5 V1R-source-selected live probe under standing autonomous authorization.

estimated_cost.compute: One serial CPU/Gazebo case; inference only, zero training and zero GPU requirement.

evidence.expected: Exact V1R audit-selection provenance, one lossless bag, case metrics, V5 trace/snapshot, correction counters, post-correction progress, RUN_STATE and seal.
evidence.fail: Any source, selection, tool, image, checkpoint, planner, readiness, correction, progress, archive or forbidden-read failure.
evidence.pass: Readiness gates pass; V5/V3 identities are exact; at least one correction activates consistently; route arc grows afterward; storage hashes pass.

method.baseline: The exact defective-V9 source case is mechanism evidence; original M-TARE remains the later primary performance baseline.
method.fallback: None. No correction activation or no later route-arc growth fails the probe.
method.main: V9 learned exit directions plus frozen B0 count/role, deterministic verified re-anchor and causal frontier execution feedback into the existing retry ledger.
method.thresholds: Frozen readiness gates and existing retry penalty only; no new research threshold or planner weight.

purpose: Live-check the frozen V5 combined graph correction on the one case selected without performance outcomes by the sealed V1R 30-case mechanism audit.

sampling.independent_units: One new 180-second closed-loop execution; nomination is derived from all 30 sealed defective-V9 cases.
sampling.selection_rule: Among cases with both diagnosed mechanisms, minimize the later of first re-anchor-proxy and first nonmatching-frontier frame; tie by case ID.
sampling.spatial_temporal_spacing: One causal closed-loop trajectory at the frozen AEE scan rate; no frame deletion or resampling for selection.
sampling.split_logic: Development-only Gate-6 probe; C09/C10 and strict-test assets remain unread.
